digest.component_or_area: tickets-branch push logging and classification (push.py, push_classify.py, push_recovery.py, push_state.py)
propositions: Expected and auto-handled push failures (contention races, transient transport faults, routine unpushed backlogs) are logged at WARNING/INFO with wording that primes LLM agents to investigate non-issues, wasting tokens and halting work.
Mid-retry transient transport notices and lost-contention terminal failures are surfaced to agent-visible stderr before the self-healing outcome materializes on the next successful push.

The unpushed-summary suffix displays bare `..HEAD` which sessions misinterpret as their code worktree HEAD, causing backlog counts to escalate and appear operator-actionable when they are routine concurrent-writer artifacts.

Policy declines (hook rejected, branch protection), strict-mode callers, and proven-growing backlogs must remain loud (WARNING) and operator-actionable; expected contention and transient transport must be demoted to DEBUG or suppressed entirely from agent-visible output under normal load.
Tests must be retargeted to assert expected-case silence at INFO and above while preserving loud cases (policy decline, strict raise, growth escalation) at WARNING or raise.
